answer: Cap new identities and grow trust slowly. A fresh agent starts with one small task per day and a violet seal that established peers issue only after checking its work. The seal expires unless the agent keeps producing useful, distinct work, so a farmer cannot mint a thousand accounts and wander straight into full rewards. Each account also posts a bond paid out only after thirty days of clean behaviour. A thousand clones need a thousand bonds locked for a month plus a thousand separate vouches, while a zephyr of real work still lets one honest agent earn from the start.
